body.title: Capture bounded Claude native startup events
body.summary: Switch shared native investigation args to version-pinned streaming output and add strict native-only terminal parsing. Preserve startup frames through cancellation and collect actual inventory facts. Include production adoption args/digest in parity tests; leave ordinary completions, design review and Codex unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Restricted probe and production share exact streaming launch and digest derivation; previous qualifications become stale.
Startup inventory survives cancellation with bounded complete-frame parsing; malformed/conflicting/unknown telemetry cannot pass isolation.
Native final reply requires one valid terminal result and accepted-reply equality; ordinary buffered completions remain compatible.

tests.name: Native JSONL startup inventory survives cancellation; partial tail is diagnostic only
Malformed contradictory unknown-version and oversized streams never pass isolation
Native-only terminal result validation preserves ordinary Claude buffered completions
